lead: Light remodel is the bigger end of what Apex does — full kitchen refreshes, bathroom remodels, and basement finish-outs in the $5k–$60k project range. We're a small crew, so we're not the right call for whole-house gut renovations or new builds. What we do well: well-managed mid-size projects where one supervisor stays on-site daily, the same crew shows up every morning, and the homeowner has one number to call. Free in-home estimate, written scope and price before any demo, and a 1-year workmanship warranty on every project.

sections.heading: Common remodel projects
sections.intro: A representative — not exhaustive — list of the projects we run end-to-end.

items.label: Kitchen refresh
items.body: Cabinet refacing or replacement, countertop swaps (quartz, butcher block, granite), backsplash, sink and faucet swap, new lighting. Typical range $12k–$35k

items.label: Full kitchen remodel
items.body: Layout-preserving full remodels with new cabinets, counters, appliances, flooring, and lighting. Typical range $35k–$60k. Layout changes that move plumbing or gas route to a partner plumber

items.label: Bathroom remodel
items.body: Tub-to-shower conversions, full bath rebuilds with tile work, vanity and toilet swaps, exhaust fans. Typical range $8k–$25k for a hall bath; $15k–$40k for a primary bath

items.label: Basement finish-out
items.body: Framing, drywall, flooring, lighting, and trim for unfinished basements. Egress windows and bathroom rough-ins coordinated with permitted partners. Typical range $20k–$60k

items.label: Mudroom and built-ins
items.body: Custom built-in benches, lockers, pantry shelving, and closet organization. Typical range $5k–$15k

items.label: Trim and finish carpentry
items.body: Wainscoting, accent walls, crown and base upgrades, custom shelving. Often added inside a larger remodel; also stand-alone

sections.heading: How a remodel project goes
sections.body: Same arc on every project from a $5k built-in to a $60k basement.
items: Free in-home estimate — owner Dave or his brother Tim walk the project with you, talk scope, and take measurements
Written scope and price within 3–5 business days; we don't email a number without seeing the space
Scheduling window typically 4–8 weeks out; longer in spring and fall when remodel demand peaks
On-site supervisor on every workday, daily clean-up, end-of-job walkthrough with photos and a 1-year workmanship warranty
